briefdescription.para: The following variables are shared between non-interrupt processing and interrupt processing such that they must be global.
The following variable tracks any errors that occur during interrupt processing.
Read buffer used during read and write transactions.
Write buffer used during read and write transactions.
Enables writes to the Intel Serial Flash memory.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.

briefdescription.para: Writes the data to the specified locations in the Intel Serial Flash memory.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.
Address in the Buffer, where to write the data.
Number of bytes to be written.

simplesect.para: A minimum of one byte and a maximum of one Page can be written using this API.

briefdescription.para: Reads the data from the Intel Serial Flash Memory.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.
Starting address in the Flash Memory from which the data is to be read.
Number of bytes to be read.

briefdescription.para: Erases the entire contents of the Intel Serial Flash.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.

briefdescription.para: Erases the contents of the specified Sector in the Intel Serial Flash.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.
Address within a sector of the Buffer, which is to be erased.

briefdescription.para: Reads the Status register of the Intel Serial Flash.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.

simplesect.para: The status register content is stored at the second byte pointed by the ReadBuffer.

briefdescription.para: Writes to the Status register of the Intel Flash.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the Spi device.
Value to be written to the status register of the flash device.

simplesect.para: The status register content is stored at the second byte pointed by the ReadPtr.

briefdescription.para: Waits till the Intel Serial Flash is ready to accept next command.

simplesect.para: The function reads the status register of the Buffer and waits till the WIP bit of the status register becomes 0.

briefdescription.para: Handles the status events of the SPI driver.

detaileddescription.para: It is called from an interrupt context such that the amount of processing performed should be minimized. It is called when a transfer of SPI data completes or an error occurs.
This handler provides an example of how to handle SPI interrupts and is application specific.

parameterdescription.para: Upper layer callback reference passed back when the callback function is invoked.
Number of bytes transferred up until the event occurred.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful, XST_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND if the SPI configuration is not found, else XST_FAILURE.
